## Project Configurations

### Setup OpenRouteService API

```{r}
#| label: setup-ors

# --- Configuration ---
# TRUE  = Use local Docker instance (Free, Unlimited, Fast)
# FALSE = Use Public Cloud API (Limited tokens, Requires Key)
USE_LOCAL_ORS <- TRUE

if (USE_LOCAL_ORS) {
  # 1. Local Setup
  local_url <- "http://localhost:8080/ors"

  # Set the option that the package looks for
  options(openrouteservice.url = local_url)

  # Local instances ignore the key, but the package sometimes checks for existence.
  # We set a dummy key to prevent errors.
  suppressMessages(ors_api_key("local-instance"))

  message("✅ Using Local ORS instance at: ", local_url)
} else {
  # 2. Remote Setup
  # Important: Clear the URL option so it defaults back to "api.openrouteservice.org"
  options(openrouteservice.url = NULL)

  # Load Key
  readRenviron(here::here("_environment"))

  if (Sys.getenv("ORS_API_KEY") == "") {
    stop("❌ ORS_API_KEY not found in _environment file.")
  } else {
    ors_api_key(Sys.getenv("ORS_API_KEY"))
    message("✅ Using Public ORS API (Key Loaded)")
  }
}
```

# Preprocessing

## Set Regional Boundary


```{r}
#| label: prep-boundary

# Define inputs/outputs
fp_regional_bound <- here::here(
  sub_dirs$base,
  "RegionalBoundaryComponents.parquet"
)
fp_boundary_wftdm <- here::here(
  sub_dirs$base,
  "Analysis_Boundary_WFRC_MAG.parquet"
)

# Define the CRS of your INPUT file 'RegionalBoundaryComponents.parquet'
# Common Utah CRSs: "EPSG:26912" (UTM 12N) or "EPSG:3566" (Utah Central State Plane)
SOURCE_CRS <- CRS_WGS

# --- Conditional Processing Block ---
if (file.exists(fp_boundary_wftdm)) {
  # File exists, skip processing
  message("✅ Analysis boundary already exists: ", fp_boundary_wftdm)
} else {
  # File does NOT exist, proceed with DuckDB SQL processing

  # Initialize In-memory database
  conn <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
  on.exit(DBI::dbDisconnect(conn, shutdown = TRUE))

  # install and load spatial extension
  DBI::dbExecute(conn, "INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;")
  DBI::dbExecute(conn, "SET geometry_always_xy = true")

  # Process using DuckDB SQL
  query_prep <- glue::glue(
    "
    COPY (
      WITH raw_union AS (
        -- 1. Initial Dissolve
        SELECT ST_Union_Agg(geometry) as geom
        FROM read_parquet('{fp_regional_bound}')
        WHERE plan_org IN ('MAG MPO', 'WFRC MPO')
      ),

      exploded_parts AS (
        -- 2. Handle MultiPolygons
        SELECT unnest(ST_Dump(geom)) as d
        FROM raw_union
      ),

      filled_polys AS (
        -- 3. Strip Holes (Make Exterior Ring -> Polygon)
        SELECT ST_MakePolygon(ST_ExteriorRing(d.geom)) as geom
        FROM exploded_parts
      ),

      final_union AS (
        -- 4. Re-Aggregate
        SELECT ST_Union_Agg(geom) as geom
        FROM filled_polys
      )

      -- 5. FINAL SELECT: Explicit Transform
      SELECT
        ST_Transform(geom, '{SOURCE_CRS}', 'EPSG:4326', always_xy := true) as geometry
      FROM final_union

    ) TO '{fp_boundary_wftdm}' (FORMAT PARQUET)
  "
  )

  # Assuming 'conn' is your active DuckDB connection
  DBI::dbExecute(conn, query_prep)
  message("✅ Analysis boundary created (DuckDB): ", fp_boundary_wftdm)
}
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

arrow::open_dataset(fp_boundary_wftdm) |>
  sf::st_as_sf(crs = CRS_WGS) |>
  mapgl::maplibre_view()
```

## Generate H3 Hexagons


```{r}
#| label: gen-h3-grid

# 1. Define Inputs/Outputs
fp_boundary_wftdm <- here::here(
  sub_dirs$base,
  "Analysis_Boundary_WFRC_MAG.parquet"
)
fp_h3_grid <- here::here(sub_dirs$base, "Analysis_Boundary_H3_Grid.parquet")
H3_RES <- 10 # Reference: https://gist.github.com/colbyn/001064f00385d253b42693c3889f9beb

if (file.exists(fp_h3_grid)) {
  message("✅ H3 Grid already exists: ", fp_h3_grid)
} else {
  conn <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
  on.exit(DBI::dbDisconnect(conn, shutdown = TRUE))

  DBI::dbExecute(conn, "INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;")
  DBI::dbExecute(conn, "SET geometry_always_xy = true")
  DBI::dbExecute(conn, "INSTALL h3 FROM community; LOAD h3;")

  query_h3 <- glue::glue(
    "
    COPY (
      WITH boundary_parts AS (
        -- 1. Read boundary (already EPSG:4326 from prep-boundary)
        SELECT unnest(ST_Dump(geometry)) as d
        FROM read_parquet('{fp_boundary_wftdm}')
      ),

      h3_indices AS (
        -- 2. Polyfill: convert each polygon part to H3 cell indices
        SELECT unnest(h3_polygon_wkt_to_cells(ST_AsText(d.geom), {H3_RES})) as h3_index
        FROM boundary_parts
      )

      SELECT DISTINCT
        h3_index,
        -- 3. Convert index back to geometry (H3 boundaries are natively 4326)
        h3_cell_to_boundary_wkb(h3_index) as geometry
      FROM h3_indices

    ) TO '{fp_h3_grid}' (FORMAT PARQUET)
  "
  )

  tryCatch(
    {
      DBI::dbExecute(conn, query_h3)
      message("✅ H3 Grid saved to: ", fp_h3_grid)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      stop("❌ H3 Generation Failed: ", e$message)
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| eval: false

arrow::read_parquet(fp_h3_grid) |>
  sf::st_as_sf(crs = CRS_WGS) |>
  mapgl::maplibre_view()
```

## Set Isochrone Inputs and Configuration

```{r}
#| label: config-layers

# Master Input Configuration
# - name: Output filename prefix
# - filter: SQL filtering logic (default "1=1")
# - paths: List of file paths (if >1, they are unioned)
layer_config <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name               , ~filter                                       , ~path                                                                         ,

  # --- TRANSIT (Split by Mode) ---
  "Transit_Local"     , "Mode IN ('Bus', 'Flex Bus', 'Microtransit')" , here::here(sub_dirs$transport, "UTA_Stops_and_Most_Recent_Ridership.parquet") ,
  "Transit_Rapid"     , "Mode IN ('BRT', 'TRAX', 'BRT, Bus')"         , here::here(sub_dirs$transport, "UTA_Stops_and_Most_Recent_Ridership.parquet") ,
  "Transit_CRT"       , "Mode = 'FrontRunner'"                        , here::here(sub_dirs$transport, "UTA_Stops_and_Most_Recent_Ridership.parquet") ,

  # --- INFRASTRUCTURE ---
  "Freeways"          , "1=1"                                         , here::here(sub_dirs$transport, "Freeway_Exit_Locations.parquet")              ,

  # --- AMENITIES ---
  "ChildCare"         , "1=1"                                         , here::here(sub_dirs$amenities, "ChildCareFacilities.parquet")                 ,
  "Healthcare"        , "1=1"                                         , here::here(sub_dirs$amenities, "LicensedHealthCareFacilities.parquet")        ,
  "Schools_PreK12"    , "1=1"                                         , here::here(sub_dirs$amenities, "Schools_PreKto12.parquet")                    ,
  "Schools_HigherEd"  , "1=1"                                         , here::here(sub_dirs$amenities, "Schools_HigherEducation.parquet")             ,
  "Grocery"           , "1=1"                                         , here::here(sub_dirs$amenities, "UtahGroceryAndFoodStores_DAF.parquet")        ,
  "Community_Centers" , "1=1"                                         , here::here(sub_dirs$amenities, "Community_Centers.parquet")
)
```

## Generate Walking Isochrones

```{r}
#| label: iso-walking

layer_config |>
  # Optional: You can filter the config first if you only want specific layers for driving
  # dplyr::filter(name %in% c("Grocery", "Healthcare")) |>
  purrr::pwalk(function(name, filter, path) {
    # Direct execution (No union logic needed)
    process_isochrones(
      path = path,
      name = name,
      profile = "foot-walking",
      range = c(300, 600, 900, 1800, 3599),
      input_filter = filter,
      boundary_path = fp_boundary_wftdm,
      save_dir = iso_dirs$walking,
      dry_run = FALSE,
      overwrite = TRUE
    )
  })
```

## Graded Park Access Buffers

```{r}
#| label: process-parks-graded

# 1. Define Inputs/Outputs
fp_park_5_in <- here::here(sub_dirs$amenities, "Parks_5min_ServiceArea.parquet")
fp_park_10_in <- here::here(
  sub_dirs$amenities,
  "Parks_10min_ServiceArea.parquet"
)
fp_parks_graded <- here::here(sub_dirs$amenities, "ParkAccess_Graded.parquet")

# 2. Define Buffer Parameters
#    Base Speed: 3 MPH (~0.25 miles per 5 mins).
#    If you strictly meant 0.25 MPH, change this value to 0.25.
SPEED_MPH <- 3.0
MPH_TO_MPS <- 0.44704 # Conversion factor: Miles/Hr to Meters/Sec

# Calculate distances in meters based on time delta from the 10-min (600s) layer
# Distance = (Target_Time - Base_Time) * Speed
calc_buffer <- function(target_seconds) {
  seconds_delta <- target_seconds - 600
  return(seconds_delta * SPEED_MPH * MPH_TO_MPS)
}

dist_900 <- calc_buffer(900) # ~ 15 min total
dist_1800 <- calc_buffer(1800) # ~ 30 min total
dist_3600 <- calc_buffer(3599) # ~ 60 min total

# 3. Conditional Processing
if (file.exists(fp_parks_graded)) {
  message("✅ Graded Park Access already exists: ", fp_parks_graded)
} else {
  # Initialize DB
  conn <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
  on.exit(DBI::dbDisconnect(conn, shutdown = TRUE))
  DBI::dbExecute(conn, "INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;")

  # SQL Logic:
  # 1. Read 5min (Val 300) and 10min (Val 600)
  # 2. Buffer 10min to create 900, 1800, 3599 tiers
  # 3. Union and Save
  query <- glue::glue(
    "
    COPY (
      WITH
      -- 1. Load 5-Min Layer (Inner Core)
      layer_5min AS (
        SELECT 300 as value,
               ST_Transform(geometry, '{CRS_WGS}', '{CRS_UTM}', always_xy := true) as geom
        FROM read_parquet('{fp_park_5_in}')
      ),

      -- 2. Load 10-Min Layer (Base for Buffering)
      layer_10min AS (
        SELECT 600 as value,
               ST_Transform(geometry, '{CRS_WGS}', '{CRS_UTM}', always_xy := true) as geom
        FROM read_parquet('{fp_park_10_in}')
      ),

      -- 3. Generate All Tiers
      tiers AS (
        -- Tier: 0-5 min (Provided)
        SELECT value, geom FROM layer_5min

        UNION ALL

        -- Tier: 5-10 min (Provided)
        SELECT value, geom FROM layer_10min

        UNION ALL

        -- Tier: 15 min (900s) -> Buffer 10min by ~0.25 miles
        SELECT 900 as value, ST_Buffer(geom, {dist_900}) as geom
        FROM layer_10min

        UNION ALL

        -- Tier: 30 min (1800s) -> Buffer 10min by ~1.0 miles
        SELECT 1800 as value, ST_Buffer(geom, {dist_1800}) as geom
        FROM layer_10min

        UNION ALL

        -- Tier: 60 min (3599s) -> Buffer 10min by ~2.5 miles
        SELECT 3599 as value, ST_Buffer(geom, {dist_3600}) as geom
        FROM layer_10min
      )

      -- 4. Final Transform back to WGS84
      SELECT
        value,
        ST_Transform(geom, '{CRS_UTM}', '{CRS_WGS}', always_xy := true) as geometry
      FROM tiers
      WHERE NOT ST_IsEmpty(geom)

    ) TO '{fp_parks_graded}' (FORMAT PARQUET)
  "
  )

  DBI::dbExecute(conn, query)
  message("✅ Saved Graded Park Access to: ", fp_parks_graded)
}
```
